details.description: Faber-Castell GR8 geometry box with compass, divider, scale, protractor, set squares, sharpener and eraser.
details.usageInstructions: Use the compass and divider with the pencil lead fitted; keep the instruments in the box.
details.dangerWarnings: Compass and divider points are sharp. Keep away from small children.
